description: This file defines the Hyperlink class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing a hyperlink object associated with spreadsheet cells. It includes properties for URL and tooltip, methods for accessing and modifying these, and utility functions such as checking if the hyperlink is internal and generating a hash code.

classes.name: Hyperlink
classes.description: Represents a hyperlink in a spreadsheet cell, managing URL, tooltip, hyperlink type, and hash code generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Hyperlink object with optional URL and tooltip.

methods.name: getTooltip
methods.description: Returns the tooltip text displayed on the hyperlink.

methods.name: setTooltip
methods.description: Sets the tooltip text to display on the hyperlink.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Determines whether the hyperlink points internally within the spreadsheet (e.g., sheet://).

methods.name: getTypeHyperlink
methods.description: Returns 'External' if the hyperlink is not internal, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the hyperlink based on URL, tooltip, and class name.
